source_semantics: Priority-ordered admitted table candidates from the same native resolver used by the timing engine. This is not a claim that every row/file supplied a query or identification of each interpolated winning row.
version_limit: The 0.31.0 backend identity has no primary attention/GDN tables; shared-layer donors include older backend versions. Do not describe these predictions as using exclusively vLLM 0.31.0 measurements.
operation_source_limit: Forward diagnostics also label static formula operations empirical and composite operations mixed; SILICON selects the table policy, not a guarantee that every component is directly measured.
